texts.arguments: It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been convicted under Sections 7(II)/(16)(i) and 7(iii)/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of six months and a fine of Rs. 500/- with default imprisonment.
